channel.title: Noderunners Radio
channel.description: Noderunners Radio is a Bitcoin community radio station with a Lightning jukebox, on air around the clock at https://noderunnersradio.com. Anyone can request a song on the website, in Telegram, on Nostr or on X, pay a few sats, and hear it on air. Now and then DJs play live sets. Boost or stream sats here to support the station.
